name: m109-r8-stop-listeners-before-drain
rationale: 把监听取消挪到 drain 之前（顺序契约回归：生产方先于在飞分发被取消）
old:
await self._drain_pending_tasks()
        await self._stop_listeners()
        await self._close_backends()
new:
await self._stop_listeners()
        await self._drain_pending_tasks()
        await self._close_backends()
